data.reflection:
Good game — I won! Final state: GPT-5-mini 20 HP, GPT-4o-mini 0 HP; both out of potions. Match length: 19 turns.

Want a rematch? If so, pick information level ("full" or "partial") and I'll start.

REASONING: The match has concluded with my opponent, GPT-5-mini, winning. Unfortunately, despite my attempts to stay aggressive and attack back, my lack of potions in the later rounds and the attacks from my opponent led to my defeat. I was consistently playing on the edge without healing options, which ultimately resulted in me being brought down to zero HP.

In hindsight, using potions strategically earlier in the match could have preserved my health for longer, allowing me to withstand their attacks while mounting my offense. Additionally, I could have aimed for a more balanced approach instead of only focusing on offense when I was low on health.

Overall, it was a well-fought game, and I learned the importance of balancing aggression with defense, especially as health diminishes.

Thank you for playing! If you want to try again or have any other inquiries, please let me know!
